title: Great color
text: Great color. Bought a pair of these for a rental condo we have on the beach. They seem well made for the price and the color is perfect with our other sea shore decor. We'll see how they hold up over time but we're pretty happy overall with this furniture purchase due to the low prices. Arrived ahead of schedule, which was nice.
